note: Registration deadlines and official links for the 2026 general election, read from each state page on vote.gov (U.S. Election Assistance Commission). Deadlines keep vote.gov's wording, which counts days before Election Day; they are never converted into guessed calendar dates. Early voting dates are not listed on vote.gov, so none are recorded here. Two link fixes: Oregon's lookup link had an HTML-escaped ampersand and Pennsylvania's election office link had a trailing period.
